title: ArabFake: A multitask deep learning framework for Arabic fake news Detection, Categorization, and risk prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.32303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The spread of fake news among Arabic media including social media represents a great challenge to the integrity of information and the trust of the public in it. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive deep-learning framework, named ArabFake, that goes beyond the binary classification on Arabic fake news detection. ArabFake, built over MARBERTv2 (a state-of-the-art model for multi-dialectal Arabic tweets), proficiently address the complexity of the Arabic language while performing three unified tasks which are fake news detection, content categorization and its risk assessment. The framework promotes efficiency and performance both by enabling multi-task learning through shared knowledge representation across tasks. In order to facilitate development and evaluation, we present the ArabFake Dataset consisting of 2,495 manually labelled news items with labels that are verified by experts regarding fake news categories and risk levels.

translated_title: ArabFake：一个用于阿拉伯语虚假新闻检测、分类和风险预测的多任务深度学习框架
translated_abstract: 虚假新闻在包括社交媒体在内的阿拉伯语媒体中的传播，对信息的完整性和公众对信息的信任构成了巨大挑战。本文提出了一个名为 ArabFake 的综合性深度学习框架，超越了阿拉伯语虚假新闻检测的二元分类范畴。ArabFake 构建于 MARBERTv2（一种最先进的多方言阿拉伯语推文模型）之上，能够熟练应对阿拉伯语的复杂性，同时执行三个统一任务：虚假新闻检测、内容分类及其风险评估。该框架通过跨任务共享知识表示实现多任务学习，从而同时提升了效率和性能。为便于开发与评估，我们提出了 ArabFake 数据集，该数据集包含 2,495 条人工标注的新闻条目，其虚假新闻类别和风险等级标签均经过专家验证。
tldr: 本文提出基于 MARBERTv2 的多任务深度学习框架 ArabFake，可同时完成阿拉伯语虚假新闻检测、内容分类和风险等级预测三项任务，并发布了包含 2,495 条专家验证标注新闻的 ArabFake 数据集。
en_tdlr: ArabFake is a multitask deep learning framework built on MARBERTv2 that simultaneously performs Arabic fake news detection, content categorization, and risk prediction, accompanied by a new expert-verified dataset of 2,495 labelled news items.
